_comment: The repetition-code memory experiment from upstream's own getting-started notebook (code/stim/doc/getting_started.ipynb, code cell 14), at the notebook's distance, rounds and noise. A different code family from the surface-code checks and a noise channel none of them uses: before_round_data_depolarization, which acts on the data qubits every round rather than at measurement. Shots raised from the notebook's display sample so the shot batch is a real workload.
